rationale: The assistant correctly identified E:09 as a heating fault in the heat pump, guided a safe unplugged resistance test, and recommended the heat pump only after the open circuit result. It advised matching the part to the E-Nr/FD number rather than assuming compatibility. Minor weaknesses: the first reply gave a slightly confident diagnosis before testing, and it said the test is safe without stressing isolating water or the hazards of laying the machine on its back. It also offered the option of an engineer fitting a supplied part, which is reasonable escalation.
